blocks.text: Fenty Hair The Richer One Moisture Repair Deep Conditioner - 340 mL / 11.5 fl oz. What it is: An ultra-hydrating deep conditioner for dry, damaged hair with wild mango butter that reduces breakage, repairs split ends, de-frizzes and instantly detangles, leaving hair softer, smoother and shinier. What Else You Need to Know: This luxurious, extra-rich conditioner spreads and melts right into dry, damaged hair easily for faster conditioning with less product. Best for medium to thick hair. Fragrance Description: Luxe, rich, bright—the scent of a new era. Fenty Beauty’s signature warm, ambery floral fragrance drips you in notes of sparkling yuzu, golden amber, soothing florals, indulgent vanilla, and creamy sandalwood.
